newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLO traders to square positions on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: OLO traders to square positions on Thursday.

text.p: Belgian OLO traders are expected to square positions on Thursday since they will be unable to react to key U.S. jobs data on Friday when the Belgian market is closed for the All Saints holiday.
On Wednesday OLO futures slipped with Bunds, following weaker U.S. Treasuries and a U.K. quarter point rate hike.

Several dealers said they were uncomfortable with the level of the Belgian 10-year bond yield spread over Bunds, now at 11 basis points. "The recent negative news about EMU has not been discounted by the market," one dealer said. Another said he expected the spread to widen to 15 bps.

One dealer said he expected Bund futures to test the downside of their 99-100 range of the past four weeks. Players were reluctant to take profits now, so close to the end of the year, but bonds could come under pressure after New Year.
"They want to keep some capital gains for next year," he said.

BIBOR and Euromarks implied forward three-month rates stood both at 3.22 percent, showing the market's confidence in the franc. Money market rates and the franc were virtually unchanged. -- Geert De Clercq, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6813, Fax +32 2 230 7710
